children: Q3 2026 revenue was C$6.1M, up C$0.2M or 3% year over year. CEO Vincent Gladu will transition out of the role and remain until April 2, 2027; the board will search for a successor.
Growth was modest; the release says net sales fell 3% YoY, with orders down 18% and new customer acquisitions down 13%.
CEO Vincent Gladu to leave role by Apr. 2, 2027
A leadership change creates execution and succession uncertainty; the board will consider internal and external candidates.
Higher order values partly offset lower order volume, but did not prevent the net sales decline.

This is a quarterly operating update alongside a planned CEO transition, with revenue growth modest and customer acquisition and order trends still negative. A successor announcement and subsequent results showing improvement in orders, customer acquisitions, and net sales would establish whether the transition and growth initiatives are gaining traction.
